name: dwmt
description: Departmental Work Management & Task Tracking System (MERN)
author: Yeakob Ali, Lecturer, Dept. of CSE, BAIUST <yeakob.cse@baiust.ac.bd>

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install --include=dev
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install --include=dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix server run check && npm --prefix client run build
